pages.lesson:
LESSON: GUIDED READING : READING FLUENCY

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.1: Guided Reading : Reading Fluency

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Guided Reading : Reading Fluency. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should we read texts with correct speed?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read a text with correct speed and expression
2. apply appropriate intonation and stress when reading texts

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GUIDED READING : READING FLUENCY
This lesson teaches Guided Reading : Reading Fluency for Grade 8 ARABIC.

STUDY STEPS
1. read a text with correct speed and expression
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. apply appropriate intonation and stress when reading texts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Guided Reading : Reading Fluency using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Guided Reading : Reading Fluency above.
2. Explain Guided Reading : Reading Fluency to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Guided Reading : Reading Fluency.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Guided Reading : Reading Fluency with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Guided Reading : Reading Fluency important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should we read texts with correct speed?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read a text with correct speed and expression
2. apply appropriate intonation and stress when reading texts

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
